stories.title: ‘Serious incident’ at Canada military base causes deaths, injuries
stories.brief: Defence Minister David McGuinty says people were killed and injured after an incident caused a major fire in Alberta.

stories.title: 'Devastating & dramatic' - Dubois stops Wardley to retain title
stories.brief: Daniel Dubois underlines his status as Britain's leading heavyweight with a devastating second-round stoppage of Fabio Wardley to retain his WBO title in London.

stories.title: Scores of Taliban killed as army retaliates border fire
stories.brief: Pakistan Army responded to unprovoked firing by the Afghan Taliban in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's Upper Kurram and Ghozgarhi, with several Taliban personnel reportedly killed in the retaliatory action, state media reported on Saturday. The army targeted the Afghan Taliban's Topsar post and Shipola base camp in the Upper Kurram sector with artillery fire, according to security sources.

stories.title: Security forces respond to unprovoked firing by Afghan Taliban along Kurram border: state media
stories.brief: Security forces have responded to unprovoked firing by Afghan Taliban forces along the Pakistan-Afghanistan border in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Upper Kurram, state broadcaster PTV News reported on Saturday.

stories.title: ‘Serious incident’ at Alberta military base causes deaths and injuries, Canada officials say
stories.brief: Patients being taken to hospitals in Edmonton as Wainwright ‘completely overwhelmed’ by number of injuries, local doctor says People have been killed and injured after an incident at one of Canada’s busiest military training bases in Alberta caused a large fire, Canada’s defence minister said Saturday.“I’m saddened to share that there have been both fatalities…

stories.title: Daniel Dubois delivers devastating second-round stoppage of Fabio Wardley to retain WBO title
stories.brief: Davison had been on the brink of throwing in the towel at the very end of the opening round but the bell sounded to end a disastrous first three minutes for Wardley. He was dropped heavily after just 17 seconds as Dubois landed a left cross followed by a pulverising right hand.

stories.title: 'Serious incident' at Canada base causes deaths, sparks fire: govt
stories.brief: Prime Minister Mark Carney had posted to X earlier on Saturday that “a serious incident creating a major fire” had occurred at the base.

stories.title: Arguments sought on defamation suit against PTI founder
stories.brief: Earlier, Khan’s counsel, Muhammad Hussain Chotia, argued for permission to meet his client at Adiala Jail, Rawalpindi, saying he needed instructions from him regarding the case and his signatures on documents. He asked the court to direct the jail superintendent to permit him to meet Khan.

stories.title: Dubois defeats Wardley to retain WBO heavyweight title
stories.brief: 'Dynamite' Daniel Dubois retained his WBO heavyweight belt with a one-sided and devastating second-round stoppage of fellow Briton Fabio Wardley in their world title rematch on Saturday.

stories.title: Trade at Taftan comes to a grinding halt
stories.brief: Cross-border commercial activities between Pakistan and Iran on Saturday halted suddenly at the Taftan border crossing. The border closure coincides with regulatory developments from the Ministry of Commerce.

stories.title: Defamation: court seeks arguments from PM's counsel
stories.brief: An additional sessions court on Saturday sought arguments from Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's counsel on a miscellaneous application in his Rs10 billion defamation suit against former prime minister Imran Khan. Imran's counsel, Muhammad Hussain Chotya, presented arguments on the miscellaneous application.

stories.brief: How will Nottingham Forest and Arsenal fare today?

stories.title: Turning the tides: Could hidden sea power energise our coastal towns?
stories.brief: Engineer David Mummery has developed a tidal energy generator that he says can change lives for people living in coastal communities.

stories.title: Major fire breaks out in Alberta after deadly incident at military base
stories.brief: Canada's defense minister said Saturday that people were killed and injured in an incident at a military base in Alberta that caused a major fire.(Image credit: John Ulan)

stories.title: ‘I felt disgusted’: MEP speaks out over nude deepfakes and urges EU action
stories.brief: When she opened the links, she found herself staring at images from one of her first ever press conferences – but the images had been digitally altered to remove her clothing.

stories.title: There's a crackdown on sports piracy - but is it already out of control?
stories.brief: The sports industry's lucrative business model is being undermined by dodgy TV sticks and illegal streaming links, writes Theo Leggett.

stories.title: How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France
stories.brief: Demonstrations across the country turned violent, with cars and buildings set alight and shops ransacked.

stories.title: Avian flu and costs among reasons for loss of captive birds at Castle Espie
stories.brief: Difficulties in transporting animals since Brexit has contributed to the decline in the number of captive birds.

stories.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
stories.brief: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz inaugurates Daanish School in Islamabad, stresses equal academic opportunities
stories.brief: Daanish schools, originally introduced by the Punjab government, aim to provide quality education to marginalised and talented students. Education Minister Khalid Maqbool Siddiqui also spoke on the occasion.
